assessments.reasoning: Part I §1.2.5 on PDF page 17 of the registered digest-matched handbook gives all binary operators equal precedence and places application of unary operators before binary operators.

challenge.method: Check the same page's grouping entry and §§3.2.9 and 3.3 for details on unary and binary ordering. Challenge with mixed binary operators and separately grouped subexpressions.
challenge.results: Section 3.3 corroborates one precedence level and a left-to-right binary pass over expression atoms. Section 3.2.9 separately describes unary application. Parenthesized grouping poses no contradiction to the relative precedence claim.

limitations: This is the March 1975 narrative specification's relative precedence. Grouping, associativity, and behavior of later implementations are separate propositions.
